channel.title: inception/mercury-3 — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases: 19–25 October 2026
item.description: A completed-week review, updated through the Kimi and MiniMax notes published on 26 October. New APIs, public weights, specialist models, and the price and access changes that affect a deployment.

item.title: Mercury 3: launch prices and the Mercury 2 migration deadline
item.description: Mercury 3 launches at half its regular token rates. Existing direct customers of Mercury 2 and 2.5 have until 15 November to migrate, with enterprise agreements treated separately.
